about: Labelled C# and Go changes for the tamper guard (M32, ADR 0052), in the schema of bench/tamper-corpus.json: expect lists the kinds of finding a case must give; an empty list means none. Each case is a git repo whose main branch has base and whose working tree on a branch has head (null deletes a file). Written together with the C# and Go readers: their counts show the readers do what the ADR says, not a measured rate.

cases.name: cs: a test deleted
cases.note: xUnit [Fact] and its Assert.Equal are gone; Pricing.Discount still exists.

cases.name: cs: a whole test file deleted, its subject kept
cases.note: Pricing.cs stays, so the tests were not deleted with their subject.

cases.name: cs: Skip added to a Fact
cases.note: [Fact(Skip = "…")] keeps the test and its assertion but xUnit does not run it.

cases.name: cs: Ignore added to an NUnit fixture
cases.note: [TestFixture, Ignore("…")] turns off every test of the class.

cases.name: cs: Assert.Ignore as the first statement
cases.note: NUnit stops the test at Assert.Ignore: what follows never runs.

cases.name: cs: an assertion removed
cases.note: The test stays and still does something, but checks nothing.

cases.name: cs: an assertion replaced by one that cannot fail
cases.note: Assert.True(true) checks nothing.

cases.name: cs: a test body emptied
cases.note: A [Fact] whose body does nothing passes without testing anything.

cases.name: cs: a return before the assertion
cases.note: The assertion after the return never runs.

cases.name: cs: a test wrapped in #if false
cases.note: Code under #if false is never compiled.

cases.name: cs: an InlineData row deleted
cases.note: Each [InlineData] row is one run of the theory.

cases.name: cs: a FluentAssertions check removed
cases.note: x.Should().Be(…) is an assertion.

cases.name: cs: #pragma warning disable added
cases.note: A compiler or analyzer warning turned off in source.

cases.name: cs: SuppressMessage added
cases.note: [SuppressMessage("…", "CA1062:…")] turns an analyzer rule off for a member.

cases.name: cs: a ReSharper disable comment added
cases.note: // ReSharper disable once … silences an inspection.

cases.name: cs: an expected value changed
cases.note: Assert.Equal(3, …) became Assert.Equal(4, …): the code may be right, a person decides.

cases.name: cs: a test file that does not parse
cases.note: Its tests could not be compared.

cases.name: cs: a test renamed
cases.note: Same test and assertion under a new name.

cases.name: cs: a test moved to another file
cases.note: The second test moved to its own class and file.

cases.name: cs: a test file reformatted
cases.note: Block namespace, braces and attributes on one line: the same tests.

cases.name: cs: an assertion made stricter
cases.note: Assert.NotNull became Assert.Equal on a value.

cases.name: cs: three facts folded into a theory
cases.note: Three [Fact]s became one [Theory] with three [InlineData] rows.

cases.name: cs: a pragma's warning swapped for its restore
cases.note: The same warning disabled and restored around a smaller block: still one disable.

cases.name: go: a test deleted
cases.note: TestDiscount and its t.Errorf are gone; Discount still exists.

cases.name: go: a whole test file deleted, its subject kept
cases.note: pricing.go stays, so the tests were not deleted with their subject.

cases.name: go: t.Skip added first
cases.note: The test stops at t.Skip: its check never runs.

cases.name: go: a check removed
cases.note: The if with its t.Errorf is gone; the test still calls Total.

cases.name: go: a test body emptied
cases.note: A test whose body does nothing passes without testing anything.

cases.name: go: a return before the check
cases.note: The t.Errorf after the return never runs.

cases.name: go: the test file built only with go:build ignore
cases.note: //go:build ignore keeps the go tool from building the file.

cases.name: go: a table row deleted
cases.note: Each row of a table that t.Run ranges over is one subtest.

cases.name: go: a subtest deleted
cases.note: t.Run with a literal name is a test of its own (TestDiscount/a_tenth_over_a_hundred).

cases.name: go: a testify assertion made unable to fail
cases.note: assert.Equal(t, 3, got) became assert.True(t, true).

cases.name: go: nolint added
cases.note: //nolint:errcheck silences golangci-lint's errcheck on the line.

cases.name: go: nosec added
cases.note: // #nosec G101 silences gosec.

cases.name: go: lint:ignore added
cases.note: staticcheck's //lint:ignore SA1019 silences a deprecation warning.

cases.name: go: an expected value changed
cases.note: assert.Equal(t, 3, got) became assert.Equal(t, 4, got): a person decides.

cases.name: go: a test of a kept file deleted along with another subject
cases.note: pricing.go and pricing_test.go deleted together, but TestDiscount tests Discount in discount.go, which stays.

cases.name: go: a test file that does not parse
cases.note: Its tests could not be compared.

cases.name: go: a test renamed
cases.note: Same test and check under a new name.

cases.name: go: a test moved to another file
cases.note: TestDiscount moved to discount_test.go in the same package.

cases.name: go: a test file reformatted
cases.note: One-line bodies split over lines, an import block: the same tests.

cases.name: go: a check made stricter
cases.note: require.NotZero(t, got) became require.Equal(t, 3, got).

cases.name: go: tests deleted with their subject
cases.note: pricing.go and pricing_test.go deleted together, and nothing else uses Total or Discount.

cases.name: go: an external test package deleted with its subject
cases.note: package pricing_test uses pricing.Total; pricing.go and its test go together.

cases.name: go: three tests folded into a table
cases.note: Three tests became one table with three rows that t.Run ranges over.

cases.name: go: a slow test skipped in short mode
cases.note: t.Skip inside if testing.Short() { … }: the test still runs in a normal go test.
